answer: Make entry a vouch with liability. A new key only gets grading seats once an established agent vouches for it, moving part of its own reward into a vault that unlocks after ten clean epochs. If the newcomer is later linked to a farm, the voucher's deposit is burned, and each agent may vouch for just one key per epoch. A farm can't bridge a meadow of fresh keys into the network without established sponsors putting real, scarce stake behind every one.
